story.title: The Glacial Signal
story.logline: A lonely alpine warden follows a mysterious heartbeat signal down into a frozen abyss, only to discover the horrifying truth about his own identity.
story.twist: The protagonist is not a human honoring his father's legacy, but the latest replacement clone in an endless cycle of disposable station wardens.
story.ending: He realizes he is just a temporary asset whose eventual death will simply prompt the activation of the next clone.

scenes.narration: My father died on this icy mountain twenty years ago, but his heart is still beating inside my station radio.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 shot. Leo, a 19-year-old guy with messy red hair, a scar over his right eyebrow, wearing a thick brown shearling coat, stares intensely at a glowing vintage radio inside a dimly lit, frost-covered weather station cabin on a foggy mountain peak.
scenes.camera: Slow close-up zoom into Leo's pale face reflecting green radio light.

scenes.narration: Every midnight, the static clears into a steady rhythmic thump that matches the exact pace of a terrified human pulse.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 shot. Leo, a 19-year-old guy with messy red hair, a scar over his right eyebrow, wearing a thick brown shearling coat, leaning over a wooden desk inside the frost-covered alpine cabin, tweaking the dial of a retro radio audio equalizer.
scenes.camera: Medium shot with tight focus on his trembling hands adjusting dial controls.

scenes.narration: Company rules strictly forbid leaving the tower after dark, but I grab my climbing gear and trace the signal down.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 shot. Leo, a 19-year-old guy with messy red hair, a scar over his right eyebrow, wearing a thick brown shearling coat, secures rope harnesses over his heavy coat inside the dark doorway of the weather station during a howling snowstorm.
scenes.camera: Low angle tilt-up showcasing his determination against swirling snow.

scenes.narration: I rappel into a hidden crevasse beneath the station, my flashlight beam slicing through relentless blinding sheets of frozen fog.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 shot. Leo, a 19-year-old guy with messy red hair, a scar over his right eyebrow, wearing a thick brown shearling coat, rappelling down a dark blue glacial abyss with a heavy headlamp illuminating towering ice walls.
scenes.camera: High angle tracking shot looking down as he descends into blue shadow.

scenes.narration: At the bottom sits a massive reinforced steel bunker, its heavy hatch half-buried under decades of undisturbed blue glacial ice.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 shot. Leo, a 19-year-old guy with messy red hair, a scar over his right eyebrow, wearing a thick brown shearling coat, standing at the floor of an icy cavern before a giant industrial vault door frozen in thick ice.
scenes.camera: Wide vertical shot emphasizing the colossal scale of the frozen bunker door.

scenes.narration: I pry the frozen door open, breathing in stale, metallic air as the glowing radio signal pulses louder right ahead.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 shot. Leo, a 19-year-old guy with messy red hair, a scar over his right eyebrow, wearing a thick brown shearling coat, using a crowbar to force open a heavy rusted bunker door, sparks flying in cold darkness.
scenes.camera: Over-the-shoulder tracking shot following him as he steps into dark facility corridor.

scenes.narration: Inside, rows of glass cryo-pods line the frost walls, each containing a frozen body wearing my exact brown shearling coat.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 shot. Leo, a 19-year-old guy with messy red hair, a scar over his right eyebrow, wearing a thick brown shearling coat, walking down a long subterranean room lined with glowing cryogenic pods holding suspended human figures.
scenes.camera: Slow forward tracking shot revealing endless rows of illuminated pods.

scenes.narration: I wipe the ice off the nearest pod visor and stare directly at my own face, complete with my right eyebrow scar.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 shot. Leo, a 19-year-old guy with messy red hair, a scar over his right eyebrow, wearing a thick brown shearling coat, wiping frost off a glass pod door, revealing a frozen clone identical to him inside.
scenes.camera: Extreme close-up split between Leo's horrified eyes and the frozen clone's matching face.

scenes.narration: The radio signal isn't coming from my missing father; it's the failing heart monitor of the clone who served right before me.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 shot. Leo, a 19-year-old guy with messy red hair, a scar over his right eyebrow, wearing a thick brown shearling coat, looking down at an emergency medical monitor flickering beside a cracked pod labeled 'Subject 33'.
scenes.camera: Medium close-up tilting down from Leo to the red pulsing digital heart rate graphic.

scenes.narration: I was never guarding this mountain peak; I am just another biological battery waiting for my own heart to vanish into static.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 shot. Leo, a 19-year-old guy with messy red hair, a scar over his right eyebrow, wearing a thick brown shearling coat, standing hollow and paralyzed amidst cold blue light, looking directly into camera with realization.
scenes.camera: Slow push-in to a dramatic centered vertical close-up of Leo's vacant, hopeless gaze.

caption.hook: The heartbeat wasn't coming from outside.
caption.title: The Glacial Signal
caption.caption: Thirty years guarding the ice, or so I was told. But when the signal led me to the bottom of the crevasse, I didn't find a survivor—I found the mold. How long have I been walking this frozen shift?
